reading: Both runs passed the three-point rule and both were fitted from scratch: the coefficient hashes differ between the two runs (8c3010ec vs e47a2a8e), so nothing from the earlier attempt was reused.
In each run the smoke capture reported the same coefficients_sha256 as the installed model, which is the evidence that the audio path actually ran the model this run produced.
The previous model is kept as model_prev_<run_id>.json; a failed stage never restores it and plays on as if the run had succeeded.

Two flow defects were found and fixed during this window: SECONDS collided with the bash special variable (config value was truncated to 0), and the fitter treated floor.npz as a calibration segment (non-packet captures now live in prep/ and checks/).
